vv70:1.1: Uccam idaṃ maṇithūṇaṃ vimānaṃ samantato dvādasa yojanāni kūṭāgārā sattasatā uḷārā veḷuriyatthambhā rucakatthatā subhā. || ||
vv70:2.1: Deviddhipatto 'si mahānubhāvo manussabhūto kim akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. || ||
vv70:3.1: So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv70:4.1: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto disvāna bhikkhuṃ tasitaṃ kilantaṃ ekāhaṃ bhikkhaṃ paṭipādayissaṃ samaṅgibhattena tadā akāsiṃ.
